source.review: C1-03 wave 2 — summoning and guardian spells whose SRD 5.2.1 text resolves as a saving throw, spell attack or attack rider rather than a creature stat block. The summoned form itself is narrated; the damage it deals is executable.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-03): each enemy that moves within 10 feet of the guardian for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a DEX save for 20 radiant, half on success; the DM selects who triggers it on each cast. The 8-hour duration and the guardian vanishing after 60 damage are tracked by the table.

Authored (C1-03): the cast makes one melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of the sword for 4d12 force damage. Moving the sword and attacking again with a bonus action on later turns are not enforced.

Authored (C1-03): creatures the spectral pack moves within 10 feet of, or that enter or end their turn there, make a DEX save for 3d10 slashing, half on success, +1d10 per slot level above 3rd; the DM selects who is affected on each cast. The pack's movement and the once-per-turn limit are tracked by the table.

Authored (C1-03): creatures of the caster's choice in the 20-foot-radius cylinder make a DEX save for 6d12 radiant, half on success, +1d12 per slot level above 7th. The SRD lets the caster instead heal one creature in the cylinder for 6d12; the DM applies that option with 서술 회복. Repeating the choice at the start of each turn and the bright light are not enforced.

primary.summary: 15피트 방출 안의 대상을 명중 굴림으로 맞출 때마다 선택한 유형(산성·냉기·화염·번개)의 피해 2d8을 추가한다.

trackedEffects.summary: 명중 시 화염 2d8 추가 (15피트 방출 안)

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-03): the caster's attack hits deal an extra 2d8 damage while the caster concentrates (up to 10 minutes). The SRD limits this to targets within the 15-foot emanation, lets the caster choose acid, cold, fire or lightning (authored as fire), and adds 2d8 per slot level above 4th; the DM lifts the rider for distant targets and the upcast dice are not scaled.

Authored (C1-03): a creature that enters the elemental's space or starts its turn within 5 feet of it makes a DEX save; on a failure it takes 8d8 damage and is Restrained until the spell ends, on a success half damage and no restraint; +2d8 per slot level above 5th. The SRD lets the caster choose acid, cold, fire or lightning (authored as fire); the repeat save to end the restraint is left to the DM.

primary.summary: 온기 방패(냉기 저항) 또는 한기 방패(화염 저항)를 두르고, 5피트 안에서 근접 공격으로 맞힌 상대는 2d8 피해를 받는다.

trackedEffects.summary: 온기 방패: 냉기 저항 · 근접 명중 시 화염 2d8 반격

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-03): for 10 minutes the caster has resistance to cold damage (the warm shield), and a creature that hits the caster with a melee attack takes 2d8 fire damage. The chill shield (fire resistance, cold retaliation) is applied by the DM.
